==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|vengeaunce||obsolete}} ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*deyḱ-}} From {{uder|en|xno|vengeaunce}}, from {{uder|en|fro|vengeance}}, {{m|fro|venjance}}, from {{m|fro|vengier||to avenge}}. Analysable as {{suffix|en|venge|ance}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈvɛnˌd͡ʒəns/}} * {{audio|en|en-us-vengeance.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛnd͡ʒəns|s=2}} * {{hyph|en|ven|geance}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # [[revenge|Revenge]] taken for an [[insult]], [[injury]], or other wrong. #* {{RQ:Dunsany Time||28|All the gods have mocked at prayer. This sin must now be punished by the '''vengeance''' of men.}} #* {{quote-av|en|year=2000|title={{w|Gladiator (2000 film)|Gladiator}}|format=film|passage=My name is Maximus Decimus Meridius, commander of the Armies of the North; General of the Felix Legions; loyal servant to the true emperor, Marcus Aurelius; father to a murdered son; husband to a murdered wife; and I will have my '''vengeance''', in this life or the next.}} #* {{quote-av|en|author=w:Sean Hannity; w:Sean Penn|title=Sean Penn joins Sean Hannity to discuss Russian invasion of Ukraine|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220411055322/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IfUORitTEBI|archivedate=11 April 2022|series=w:Hannity|publisher=w:Fox News|date=April 5, 2022|time=22:33|text=Penn: I don't want to invest in the conversation, not that I don't have it privately, about my feelings about what direct action should happen to a leader who does that, but if there is a God, there will be '''vengeance''' beyond all possible comprehension.
Hannity: "'''Vengeance''' is mine saith the Lord", quoted in a very famous book.}} # Desire for revenge. #* {{RQ:Dickens Little Dorrit|passage=Thereupon full of anger, full of jealousy, full of '''vengeance''', she forms {{...}} a scheme of retribution, {{...}}}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=2008|author=Jean Harvey Baker|title=Mary Todd Lincoln: A Biography|isbn=0393075680 |passage=If her husband was all forgiveness, asking the bands to play “Dixie,” she was full of '''vengeance''' {{...}}}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=James Calloway|title=Black America, Not in This America|isbn=1462868576 |passage=Are they full of '''vengeance'''[?], because they say that people with '''vengeance''' in their hearts must dig two graves, one for their enemy and the other for themselves.}} ====Synonyms==== * {{l|en|reprisal}} * {{l|en|retaliation}} * {{l|en|retribution}} * {{l|en|revenge}} * {{l|en|wreck}} * See also [[Thesaurus:revenge]] ====Antonyms==== * {{l|en|reconciliation}} ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|countervengeance|revengeance|belly vengeance|pinch-belly vengeance|whip-belly vengeance|whistle-belly vengeance|with a vengeance}} ====Related terms==== {{col|en|venge|venger|vengeful}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|revenge taken for an insult, injury, or other wrong}} * Arabic: * Armenian: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chechen: * Chinese: * Cornish: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Estonian: * Faroese: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * Georgian: * German: * Gothic: * Greek: * Hebrew: * Hindi: * Hungarian: * Ido: * Indonesian: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Korean: * Latin: * Latvian: * Macedonian: * Malay: * Malayalam: * Maltese: * Māori: * Occitan: * Ossetian: * Persian: * Plautdietsch: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|месть|f}}, {{t+|ru|мще́ние|n}}, {{t+|ru|воздая́ние|n}}, {{t+|ru|рева́нш|m}} * Scottish Gaelic: * Slovak: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: * Vietnamese: {{trans-bottom}}
